why: Hits of scripts/check-mojibake.mjs that a human has read and judged deliberate.
All twelve occurrences in this repository are the same thing: the ten README files of the root
and packages/dsh sets, plus SESSION-STATE.md, quote the dash-then-question-mark sequence
verbatim, inside backticks, in the section that records the incident. The corrupted form is the
evidence there -- a README that describes this defect without showing it is a worse README -- so
the guard would otherwise fail on the documentation that justifies its own existence.
Only Markdown documents may be listed, and each number is the count of hits at review time.
A file with fewer hits than it was reviewed with is reported as stale, so this list shrinks when
the prose it excuses is rewritten; a file with more fails the excess. Nothing under src/, lib/,
scripts/ or .github/ may be listed: in code and build output the sequence is the defect, and
check-mojibake.mjs refuses an entry that names one.
A deliberate sample in a file that can carry a comment should use the inline marker instead:
a line containing `mojibake:allow <reason>` excuses its own hits and nothing else.
